title.zh: 给 WebRTC 留一脚刹车

summary.en: Fleet added a peer-to-peer data channel while keeping control, revocation, and support for older clients at the hub.
summary.zh: Fleet 加了点对点数据通道，但控制连接、撤销能力和旧版兜底仍然留在中枢。

title.en: Bringing your own computers into an AI workflow
title.zh: 把自己的电脑接进 AI 工作流

summary.en: Fleet connects computers you already own to AI and keeps each remote job on the device you chose.
summary.zh: Fleet 把你已有的电脑接进 AI，并让每个远程任务留在选定的设备上。

title.en: Where the safety boundary belongs in remote computer control
title.zh: 远程操作电脑时，安全边界放在哪里

summary.en: Fleet reduces device exposure, protects long-lived credentials, and leaves the final execution decision on the device.
summary.zh: Fleet 减少设备暴露并保护长期凭据，最终由本机决定是否执行。
